info.title: OMA Global Navigation Satellite System (Object ID 3430)

Global_Navigation_Satellite_System.label: Global Navigation Satellite System
Global_Navigation_Satellite_System.description: More than a positioning object, the uCIFI global navigation satellite system object provides all the information required to calculate a position/location.

Fix_timestamp.label: Fix timestamp
Fix_timestamp.description: Timestamp of when the location measurement was performed.

Latitude.label: Latitude
Latitude.description: Decimal notation of latitude, e.g. -43.5723 [World Geodetic System 1984]. This value ranges from [-90, 90].

Longitude.label: Longitude
Longitude.description: Decimal notation of longitude, e.g. 153.21760 [World Geodetic System 1984]. This value ranges from [-180, 180].

Altitude.label: Altitude
Altitude.description: Altitude above mean sea level in meters.

Speed.label: Speed
Speed.description: Horizontal speed calculated by the device.

Heading.label: Heading
Heading.description: Direction that the device is following

Radius.label: Radius
Radius.description: Radius of a circular area corresponding to the location’s uncertainty (GPS data precision). Negative values indicate that the radius is not available.

Fix_type.label: Fix type
Fix_type.description:
Possible values are : 
					0 = No fix
					1 = Autonomous GNSS fix
					2 = Differential GNSS fix
					3 = GPS PPS
					4 = RTK-fixed
					5 = RTK-floated
					6 = Estimated fix
					7 = Dead reckoning fix
					8 = Manual input, surveyed
					9 = Simulated mode
					.

Fix_dimension.label: Fix dimension
Fix_dimension.description:
Possible values are: 
					0,1 = no fix
					2 = 2D fix
					3 = 3D fix 
					As per NMEA-0183 GSA.

Used_satellites.label: Used satellites
Used_satellites.description: Number of satellites used for the fix.

Visible_satellites.label: Visible satellites
Visible_satellites.description: Number of satellites viewed. Represent all the satellites seen but some of them cannot be in use (e.g. bad signal).

Almanac.label: Almanac
Almanac.description:
Validity of the almanac. Possible values are: 
					0 = invalid
					1 = valid
					.

Ephemeris.label: Ephemeris
Ephemeris.description:
Validity of the ephemeris of each satellite. Possible values are : 
					0 = invalid
					1 = valid
					.

Signal-to-noise_ratio.label: Signal-to-noise ratio
Signal-to-noise_ratio.description: Strength of the signal for each satellite, also called carrier-to-noise.

GNSS.label: GNSS
GNSS.description:
GNSS used for the fix. A mask is used with the following bit definition:
					0 = GPS (USA)
					1= GALILEO (EU)
					2 = GLONASS (Russia)
					3 = BeiDou (China)
					4 = QZSS (Japan)
					5 = IRNSS/NAVIC (India)
					A 0 indicates that the GNSS is not used a 1 indicates it is used.

Hardware_RTC.label: Hardware RTC
Hardware_RTC.description: Time of the internal clock of the GNSS hardware.

Assisted_GPS.label: Assisted GPS
Assisted_GPS.description: Set to True if the almanac is obtained via a cellular connection. Set to False otherwise.

Power_command.label: Power command
Power_command.description: Command to switch the hardware ON or OFF and status of the device.
